text:
Tracking is emailed to you when your order ships, and it can take up to **24 hours** to update after that. So if you only just received the email, it's worth checking back within a day.

If the tracking hasn't moved for **4 business days**, or it shows delivered but nothing has arrived, contact us and we'll open a courier investigation, which takes up to **5 business days**. If the parcel turns out to be lost, you can choose either a free replacement or a full refund.

One thing to keep in mind: live plants only ship Monday to Wednesday. If you ordered a plant after 12 noon on Wednesday, it will ship the following Monday, so there may be no tracking yet for that reason. Weather holds can also delay live plants by up to 7 days, and we'd email you if that applied.

If you haven't received a shipping email at all, send me your order number (it looks like LF-123456) and I can help you work out what's going on.
